description: Election Commission - Notice under Section 10A (1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance - Walallawita Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of the Walallawita Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in their political party. This is a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance specifically concerning the status of an elected member of a local government body, making it clearly related to electoral processes.
